title: Deputy General Manager Nuclear Engineering
description:
**Job Purpose**
To lead and manage the Nuclear Engineering department, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and cost-effective engineering solutions for nuclear pump applications within defined timelines, in externally constrained environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Project Ownership
* Own end-to-end technical responsibility for nuclear project pumps
* Lead preparation of design concepts, technical proposals, and tender documentation
* Participate in pre-order technical discussions with customers
* Ensure design compliance with applicable codes, standards, and specifications post-order
* Oversee full execution lifecycle, ensuring on-time delivery in complex and constrained project scenarios
* Provide technical leadership during:

+ Manufacturing
+ Inspection & testing

* Support installed base and legacy products
* Engineering Function Leadership & Capability Building
* Build, scale, and strengthen the Nuclear Engineering function
* Define and institutionalize:

+ Engineering guidelines and best practices
+ Design standards and procedures
+ Quality and compliance frameworks

* Drive process standardization and continuous improvement
* Develop high-performing teams capable of delivering under tight timelines and complex technical conditions
* Design, Development & Innovation
* Lead and execute new product development and engineering studies
* Monitor & validate:

+ Technical calculations
+ Design simulations
+ FEA analysis

* Conceptualize and develop:

+ Models
+ Detailed engineering drawings

* Ensure design robustness aligned with execution timelines
* Governance, Decision-Making & Execution Excellence
* Take critical technical decisions balancing safety, quality, cost, and timelines
* Establish strong engineering governance frameworks
* Drive disciplined execution in high-pressure, complex project environments
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure seamless, timely project delivery

**Key Skills & Competencies**
**Technical Expertise**

* Experience in High Energy Centrifugal Pump Design
* Exposure to Rotating Machinery / Heavy Equipment Engineering (preferred)
* Expertise in:

+ ASME Section III NB/NC (preferred)
+ OR ASME Section VIII Div-1

* Proficiency in:

+ Finite Element Analysis (FEA)
+ Pressure Vessel Design
+ Engineering drawings and documentation

* Knowledge of nuclear standards (preferred)

**Leadership & Behavioural Skills**

* Proven ability to build and scale engineering organizations
* Experience in setting up engineering processes, guidelines, and governance
* Strong decision-making capability in high-stakes scenarios
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills
* Strong planning, execution, and stakeholder management skills

**Qualification & Experience**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (Mandatory)
* M.Tech (Mechanical) – Preferred
* 15+ years of experience, including:

+ Minimum 10 years in relevant engineering domain
+ Experience in leading teams and managing complex project execution

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in NPCIL projects or nuclear ecosystem
* Exposure to regulated industries with tight timelines and compliance requirements
* Track record of driving execution excellence under constraints

title: PIPING ENGINEER
description:
Thorough knowledge and hands on experience of piping specification, fabrication and erection techniques
  
  
Development of Piping Schedule in line with master Schedule & Front release plan in consultation with E&P. Estimation of Resources & reduction of rework; productivity improvement. Manage the construction activities and execute the construction works in line with the approved contract schedule and specifications. Develop and implement the requirements of the Construction Execution Plan. Ensure adherence to the project/corporate HSE procedures and maintaining a safe working environment. Responsible for generating regular progress reports for review by Management. Monitoring subcontractor and vendor performance and contributes to project evaluation of these in project close-out reports. Ensure that the construction areas are constructed to international quality standards and agreed budget, schedule, and construction sequence. Knowledge on Implementation of construction work pack (CWP) is preferred, Ensure compliance of manuals, procedures, and systems. Manage the Piping Construction team creating an atmosphere of cooperation and team spirit. Develop the staff so that every supervisory position has a Deputy able to stand in for absences and rotation leave. Identifying and mentoring high potential personnel and recent college/university graduates and allowing training time. Representation in all meetings with clients and subcontractors responsibly Ensure healthy & cordial relation with client throughout project. Cost Control & Billing Certification (Client & Subcontractors) for Piping Co-ordination with Material & Consumable Procurement. Reconciliation of Material and Billing quantity.

title: Assistant Manager – Exim and Transport Management
description:
**Job Posting Title**
 Assistant Manager – Exim and Transport Management
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
* Oversee end\-to\-end import/export processes, including booking containers, tracking shipments, and optimizing transportation routes to reduce costs.
* Prepare, verify, and process documentation, including Bills of Entry, Packing Lists, Invoices, and Certificates of Origin. Ensure strict compliance with DGFT, customs, and FEMA regulations.
* Liaise with Custom House Agents (CHA) and authorities to resolve clearance issues and expedite cargo movement.
* Negotiate freight rates, contracts, and service level agreements (SLAs) with shipping lines, airlines, and logistics providers.
* Maintain accurate records of transactions, analyze inventory levels, and prepare reports on logistics performance.
* Manage all processes and functions within logistics department right from ordering to dispatch and invoicing
* Managing entire order processing activities including planning, requirement analysis \& resource management to execute order to meet the committed delivery schedule
* Lead the logistics cost optimization initiatives and continuous improvement project.
* Handled the DGFT license, incentive schemes, customs compliance and international Logistic activity.
* Interface with Regional and Global Logistics team and business divisions to ensure the alignment with organization objective.
